own_site_check: 1) Tested carloslawnservices.com (obvious domain variant of the business name): it DOES resolve (DNS A records 15.197.148.33 / 3.33.130.190) and returns HTTP 200, but curl of the live page shows only a JS redirect to /lander, and that /lander page's payload is `window.LANDER_SYSTEM='PW'` with `window._trfd.push({ap:'parking'})`: this is a domain-parking / for-sale landing page (parking-service markers), not a real business website. No business content, no contact info, no branding matching Carlos Lawn Services appears anywhere on the domain. 2) Tested carloslawnservice.com and carloslawnserviceskissimmee.com: both fail DNS (NXDOMAIN, no A record). 3) WebSearch for 'Carlos Lawn Services' + Kissimmee + facebook/instagram returned no matching social profile (only unrelated same-name businesses in other states: Dunedin FL, Stafford TX, Fitchburg MA, etc.). Conclusion: has_own_site = false. The only real public presence is the GreenPal marketplace profile.
email_notes: Deep search per PIPELINE.md Fase 1 punto 7: (a) GreenPal profile page fully fetched and parsed (HTML + all JSON-LD blocks, ImageObject and FAQPage types) - no email, no mailto: link anywhere on the page; contact is restricted to GreenPal's own Message/Request-a-Call/Make-a-Payment (Stripe) buttons, no direct address shown even to prospective customers; (b) no Instagram or Facebook profile could be found for this business (see own_site_check and ig_source), so no bio/About email search was possible; (c) carloslawnservices.com is a parked domain with no contact page of any kind (see own_site_check). No email found through any available channel; registered as null per the pipeline's no-fabrication rule.

photos_descartadas: Downloaded all 40 images referenced on the GreenPal profile page. Cross-checked against the page's own JSON-LD ImageObject blocks: exactly 25 of the 40 are captioned 'Before-and-After Lawn Mowing Job in [Kissimmee|Orlando|St. Cloud], FL by a GreenPal Pro' (the vendor's real completed-job photos); the other 15 are GreenPal reviewer profile-picture headshots/selfies (customers who left reviews), confirmed by visual inspection of a contact sheet, and correctly excluded per DESIGN.md's ban on portraits/selfies in the gallery. All 25 real job photos carried a baked-in 'GREENPAL' logo watermark band (top ~45px) and a 'Lawn Service by Carlos Lawn Services' caption band (bottom ~30px) on their native 340x255px size; all 25 were cropped with ImageMagick (340x180+0+45) to remove both text/logo overlays before use, verified visually via contact sheet post-crop (clean, no residual text, no watermark). From those 25 clean photos, 11 were selected for the site (1 hero + 10 gallery) choosing the most vibrant/varied lawns (different houses, driveway styles, lighting) and discarding near-duplicate driveway angles of the same handful of properties to avoid repetition; the other 14 clean job photos were left unused but are not degraded in any way, just surplus.
brand_vibe: Everyday Florida residential lawn care: single-story suburban homes, palm trees, concrete and paver driveways, deep green freshly-mowed grass with crisp mower lines. No branded uniforms, trucks or logo visible in the photos (just the completed yard work itself). Natural, grounded, sunlit aesthetic, not polished/luxury. Chose a LIGHT template with a warm, botanical sage-green palette (DESIGN.md 'pausa' token family) to match the real grass tones in the photos rather than an invented dark/moody look.
